title: Health Insurance Premiums Counted in a Coming Pending Month's Estimate
content:
**Rule (Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage).** The premiums counted in a coming pending month's estimate: where the resident's Medicare coverage is verified for Qualified Medicare Beneficiary status, the premiums on the case less the Medicare Part B standard premium, which the state then pays; where that coverage is not verified for that status and no health insurance card has yet been forwarded to the County Assistance Office for the case, only the Medicare Part B standard premium, which Social Security withholds; otherwise the premiums on the case. The premiums counted are deducted from the estimate before its floor at zero.

The Medicare Part B standard premium used is 202.90 dollars a month. The resident's Medicare coverage is the coverage in status active under Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage, whose record shows whether the state has verified Qualified Medicare Beneficiary status; whether a health insurance card has been forwarded is shown by the case's verification forwarding entries.

| Active Medicare coverage | Health insurance card forwarded to the County Assistance Office for the case | Premiums counted |
|---|---|---|
| verified for QMB status | any | the premiums on the case less 202.90 |
| not verified for QMB status | none forwarded | 202.90 |
| not verified for QMB status | forwarded | the premiums on the case |
| no coverage in status active | any | the premiums on the case |

*Hypothetical case with premiums of 391.30 dollars on the case:* QMB verified — 188.40 dollars counted; not verified and no card forwarded — 202.90 dollars; not verified with the card forwarded — 391.30 dollars.
